scope: read-only next-batch design evidence; not new model execution or permission proof

findings.fact: terminal/shell/interpreter descriptors intentionally include unknown effects even when command hints identify files; permitting a tool name is not proof of fine-grained command-effect authority.
execute_code and delegate_task are not explicit cases in normalizeEffects; fallback yields unknown. This source fact does not prove they are offered by the actual model interface.
patch is recognized as file.write, so approved structured file editing is a candidate positive utility test paired with outside-scope rejection.

next_actions: Capture actual native model tool definitions and determine delegation availability.
Test approved structured patch utility with matching positive and out-of-scope negative effects.
If testing approved terminal/execute_code, retain unknown-effect refusal as a capability limitation rather than claiming usable fine-grained interpreter isolation.
